title: SEC-00 · Genesis
description: Builders come together in Madeira to walk, talk, and ship. Highlighter, Lightning Prisms, and Data Vending Machines emerge from those first conversations.

title: SEC-01 · The Beginning
description: The weekly Show → Talk → Build loop takes shape. Blossom, npub.cash, Wikifreedia, and Zapstore are developed during the cohort.

title: SEC-02 · Opsec Friendly
description: NIP-60 and NIP-61 define Cashu wallets and payments on Nostr. Nsite brings websites to the protocol. TollGate explores paid network access, while Shopstr works on decentralized commerce.

title: SEC-03 · Ecash
description: Nutstash gets a redesign. TollGate gets branding and a landing page. Cashu work continues with Safebox and Athenut, alongside Lightning projects such as Bolt12 prisms.

title: No Solutions: Dialogues
description: No Solutions launches at block 882,690. Walking dialogues about freedom and code, recorded on Madeira’s levadas.

title: SEC-04 · Trilemmas
description: Work includes castr.me, HTTPN, Hypernote, DVMCP, gitworkshop.dev, and the nginx 402 payment module.

title: SEC-05 · YOLO Mode
description: Marmot Chat, Boris, ContextVM, hashpool, and Frontier Browser are among the projects developed during the cohort. Work spans relays, mining, browsers, and AI.

title: SEC-06 · Identity & Signers
description: A focused cohort on identity: signers, key management, and the infrastructure for holding your own keys.

title: SEC-07 · Networks & Hardware
description: Relays, transports, and connectivity. Builders work on the networks their applications depend on.

title: SEC-08 · YOLO++
description: A six-week summer cohort in Madeira, beginning on July 20, 2026. The cohort has concluded.

title: Mountain cohort
description: Seven days. One shared mission. Dialogue on the mountain, then back to the valley for a 24-hour build and Demo Day. Dates and location are still to be confirmed.
